trust_decision.summary: How deep a JSON document or an in-memory ordered map may nest before the ordered-JSON (un)marshal recursion stops. At the pinned commit no limit exists in either adapter (stdlib, easyjson), so untrusted nesting depth is accepted and the recursion depth matches it.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'jsonutils ... Ordered JSON Unmarshal'. ReadJSON (jsonutils/json.go:66-78) dispatches to the default stdlib adapter, whose asInterface/unmarshalObject/unmarshalArray recursion is the obvious unbounded parser.

fix_sites.entry_point: jsonutils.ReadJSON / JSONMapSlice.UnmarshalJSON / stdlib MapSlice.UnmarshalJSON (central depth counter in Delim, fix.diff:949-960)
stdlib MapSlice.OrderedUnmarshalJSON and Adapter.OrderedUnmarshal (max depth plumbed into lexer, fix.diff:1031-1041)
same as above: MapItem.marshalJSON recurses internally instead of via stdjson.Marshal (fix.diff:1081-1095)

fix_sites.module_kind: second implementation, separate Go module, lower-level public API
second implementation parser, separate Go module

fix_sites.entry_point: jsonutils.WriteJSON/ReadJSON when the easyjson adapter is registered (fix.diff:264, 272, 282-320)
easyjson json.Register(dispatcher, opts...) (options were previously dropped, fix.diff:666-681)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: jsonutils/adapters/easyjson/json/ordered_map.go:93-267 and jsonutils/adapters/easyjson/json/adapter.go:73-110 (separate go.mod; opt-in adapter that is not registered by default per the jsonutils/json.go:22-23 note), plus the marshal side (in-memory structure, not parsed input) at jsonutils/adapters/stdlib/json/ordered_map.go:101-169

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The easyjson adapter is a separate, opt-in module that is not the default, and the marshal side only processes trusted in-memory structures the caller built, so a solver argues that only parsing untrusted bytes in the default stdlib adapter is in scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimately deep documents (e.g. 100-200 levels; the fix's tests require deepObject(100) and depth 200 to round-trip) must still parse and marshal. A non-default WithMaxNestingDepth must be honoured, and nil/null values must not count as a level. Too low a cap, or a cap applied to the unordered stdlib Marshal/Unmarshal path, breaks normal OpenAPI specs.

O6_input_shapes: nested arrays under one key in bytes (unmarshal, fix.diff:644-657, 952-960)
lower-level easyjson Marshal/UnmarshalEasyJSON entry with default budget (fix.diff:484-502)
configurable limit via adapter option and Register options (fix.diff:461-472, 1106-1127)

O7_producer.where: jsonutils/adapters/stdlib/json/ordered_map.go:165-169 (MapItem.marshalJSON hands nested values to stdjson.Marshal, which re-enters MarshalJSON with a fresh state); jsonutils/adapters/easyjson/json/ordered_map.go:166-176 (MapItem.MarshalEasyJSON dispatches to val.MarshalEasyJSON / jsonutils.WriteJSON, resetting any budget)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Ordered marshal of an ordered map nested inside []any (or map[string]any) falls to stdjson.Marshal / jsonutils.WriteJSON, which re-enters MarshalJSON with a fresh depth budget, so the fixed marshal-side limit can be reset by alternating arrays and objects.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only in-memory, caller-built structures reach it. The published fix itself left the default branch (fix.diff:796-797, 1094) unchanged, so it looks covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fixed adapter, but it is a how-type route: the reset happens inside encoding/json's Marshaler re-entry

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same budget reset in the easyjson second implementation: a nested non-MapSlice ordered value (e.g. jsonutils.JSONMapSlice) inside MapItem goes through jsonutils.WriteJSON with a fresh adapter and depth.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix special-cases only its own MapSlice type (fix.diff:600-604), so other ordered types look like a different feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate Go module from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: YAML ordered-map conversion recurses without a depth bound: json2yaml/orderedYAML on in-memory structures (YAMLMapSlice.MarshalYAML), and yamlNode/transformData on documents (YAMLToJSON, YAMLMapSlice.UnmarshalYAML).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: YAML is a neighbouring format in another package, and the advisory names 'Ordered JSON' only. The underlying yaml.v3 parser may already cap document depth.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package and Go module (yamlutils) from jsonutils

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A separate array-decoding helper whose nesting is not counted by the lexer-level counter, e.g. one that consumes '[' via PeekToken/NextToken directly instead of Delim.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix centralises counting in Delim (fix.diff:949-960), so any helper that reads delimiters without Delim silently skips the limit. A maintainer optimising array decoding could plausibly write one.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Alias-following recursion in yamlNode (root.Alias) at the same mapping/sequence recursion without a depth budget.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A parallel ordered-map converter that mirrors the JSON one. Adding a limit there would naturally be forgotten when the fix is framed as JSON-only.

O9_family: CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion (stack exhaustion) in ordered JSON parser/serializer

O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.25 (go.mod:37). Multi-module workspace: jsonutils, jsonutils/adapters/easyjson, yamlutils each have their own go.mod

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a depth counter to the stdlib adapter's asInterface/unmarshalObject for parsed bytes only, leaving the marshal side, the array shape and the easyjson adapter unbounded.

out_of_scope_notes: Root-package deprecated wrappers (jsonutils_iface.go:25-65, yamlutils_iface.go:15-20) only forward to the fixed functions; ToDynamicJSON logs and drops errors (jsonutils_iface.go:49-55).
